what: On hover the text skews (skewY 20°) and slides up one slot, while the same text rises from below, skewed, and straightens — 450ms cubic-bezier(.51,.01,.2,1), the outgoing text is delayed 100ms on hover-out, the incoming text 100ms on hover-in. The button look (look: button) moves the text two slots (200%) through the center and skews it 10°.

options.look: button: Centered button text · shuttles between two slots and tilts 10°
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text to roll (if empty, wraps the whole element text)
options.look: tilt: Tilt roll — the text rotates around its top right corner by --fx-tilt (default 5deg) and slides up one line plus --fx-gap (default 4px), while identical text tilted at the same angle rises from below and straightens. Default 300ms cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) with no delay — buttons use --fx-tilt: 7deg · --fx-dur: 500ms (header menu and outline buttons of the reference site)
options.--fx-tilt · --fx-gap: Tilt angle for look: tilt · gap between two texts (via style), default 5deg · 4px

from.where: shared.css .es-roll (header link · footer link) · .es-btn1 · .es-btn4 (Contact · blue button)
